description: Land Acquisition - Trincomalee Town and Gravets D/S Division, Trincomalee District - Correction Notice - Gaz. Ex. No. 2140/44 dated 11.09.2019 Bulathkohupitiya D/S Division, Kegalle District
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively concerns land acquisition matters under the Land Acquisition Act. It contains detailed descriptions of specific land parcels (lot numbers, extents, boundaries) in Trincomalee District and a correction notice regarding lot number revisions for land allotments in Bulathkohupitiya. The content focuses entirely on land/property matters without any government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or other non-land administrative matters, making it clearly a Land Gazette (Type 4).
